messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty fired — INC-202473: gpu.memory.alloc_fail (CUDA OOM) in cluster west2a, pool "inference-west2a-gpu". Severity: P1. Affected services: embedder-svc, chat-api. PD link: https://pagerduty.example/INC-202473

alice_oncall: acking — Alice (oncall). I'm on it. Seeing spikes at ~12:02 UTC, lots of 500s from embedder.

ben_infra: joining. checking node/pod state now.

carla_sre: quick ask — any visibility into customer impact yet?

alice_oncall: embedder-svc returning 503 with "cudaMalloc failed" in app logs. chat-api slower but small requests still ok.

ben_infra: `kubectl get pods -n prod -o wide | grep embedder` => 3/5 pods CrashLoopBackOff on node gpunode-17.

ben_infra: logs snippet:
```
E runtime: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
2024-08-07T12:02:58Z runtime: alloc failed
```

alice_oncall: immediate mitigation plan: cordon gpunode-17, drain non-essential pods, scale down batch/worker jobs. Doing cordon now.

carla_sre: +1. Support team should be prepped to flag impacted customers and surface to CS.

support-bot: Support ticket created #SUP-9876 for embedder-svc 503s. Notifying Customer Success.

alice_oncall: Node cordoned and drain started. Restarted embedder pods; first pod came up but still reports high GPU memory. Uploading `nvidia-smi` snapshot to #eng-infra.

ben_infra: Observed GPUs at ~100% on two nodes — looks like model process holding KV cache (possible leak). Will perform rolling restart of model pods with `--clear-kv` flag to drop caches.

alice_oncall: Executing `kubectl rollout restart deployment/embedder --namespace prod` (rolling, maxUnavailable=1). Watching pod readiness.

infra-lead: oncall handoff in ~10m. If still active, I'll take ownership. Recommend quantized fallback (8-bit) to reduce per-replica memory footprint.

ben_infra: Deployed quantized model variant to 2 replicas behind a canary. Memory per replica dropped ~40% in initial samples.

carla_sre: For safety, enabling partial traffic fallback to CPU pool for small requests: `route-manager switch embedder -> cpu-fallback (10%)` to reduce tail risk.

alice_oncall: Manual PD ack, added note to incident. Will escalate if not stable in 15m.

alice_oncall: 12:18 UTC — embedder 200s returned to normal for most traffic; CrashLoopBackOffs stopped. Large-batch requests still hit OOM; throttling batch size and setting stricter QoS.

carla_sre: Customer impact summary: embedder-svc experienced ~5 minutes of 503s affecting two customers (C-123, C-789). CS/Support notified and ticket linked.

alice_oncall: Post-incident actions: add per-node GPU memory alert (threshold 90% for 3m), add KV cache TTL guardrail, enforce max batch size in ingress, and create a runbook entry for quantized-fallback.

incident-bot: PagerDuty INC-202473 marked resolved by alice_oncall at 1732470900.
